description: This file is a shell script for testing 'git rev-list --pretty=format' with various configurations, encodings, and color options. It sets up different repository states, runs tests, and verifies output formatting for Git's revision listing functionality.

methods.name: test_format
methods.description: Runs a Git rev-list command with a specified format string and compares its output to expected output.

methods.name: test_pretty
methods.description: Runs a Git rev-list command with a pretty format and compares output to expected.

methods.name: has_color
methods.description: Checks if color sequences are correctly decoded from the Git output.

methods.name: has_no_color
methods.description: Checks if the output lacks color sequences as expected.
